Text: Barcelona has won its first eight matches of a LaLiga season for the second time in its entire history, having previously achieved this in the 2013/14 season with Gerardo Martino.

Barça has scored 34 goals in LaLiga 2026/27, with only Sevilla in the 1940/41 season (41) managing more goals after its first eight matches of a season in the competition (34 also for Athletic in the 1930/31 season).
🚨🇫🇷 Jules Koundé enters FC Barcelona's history by becoming the most capped Frenchman for the club with 194 appearances, ahead of Éric Abidal (193)! 🔵🔴🔥

FC Barcelona has scored 80 goals in 27 Champions League matches since Hansi Flick 🇩🇪 took charge, at an average of 2.96 per game. This is the highest goals-per-game ratio for any club with 20 or more matches under the same coach in the competition (since 1992-93).
